Scope: India-focused. “All universities” is not a single fixed syllabus; universities retain autonomy and revise curricula. The workbook therefore uses UGC guidance plus representative DU/IISc curricula and CSIR-NET coverage to identify broadly reusable UG–PhD gaps. State boards are represented through national-framework overlap and official Maharashtra/Kerala examples, not a claim of line-by-line coverage of every state edition.
